story: Label alignment becomes intermittently inconsistent after a roll change while bottle presentation variability is elevated. The operator stops production, enters careful diagnostic mode, applies one standard guide/spacing change, arms a five-bottle LineAlert trial, executes the machine run from the HMI, and then returns to production for separate recovery verification.
truth_boundary: Scenario truth exists only to coordinate synthetic source outputs. It is not commissioned machine truth, OEM guidance, a diagnosis, or evidence about a physical machine.

design_assumptions.intent: Historical maintenance evidence is a first-class ranking input. Routine troubleshooting-guide interventions are commissioned to the operator by default in this demo. LineAlert distinguishes production, stopped/idle, and bounded diagnostic modes and never treats arming a trial as equipment execution.

production_running.meaning: Normal production context. Continuous output and production consequences apply.

stopped_idle.meaning: Production is stopped and no bounded diagnostic trial is active.

bounded_diagnostic.meaning: Production is intentionally stopped for a controlled diagnostic sequence of five consecutive bottles.
bounded_diagnostic.boundary: LineAlert initiation does not command the machine.

timeline.operator_context: Operator has intentionally stopped normal production to run controlled five-bottle diagnostic batches.

timeline.change: Restore guide / spacing to the approved marked setup reference
timeline.change_boundary: Synthetic routine operator-friendly standard change. No second material change is permitted before fresh evidence.

timeline.linealert_effect: Trial intent, selected change, timestamp, and expected evidence window are recorded.
timeline.next_required_action: Operator executes the five-bottle run from the HMI.

timeline.verification_boundary: The diagnostic run may support the standard change under test conditions, but production recovery remains a separate observation.

historical_evidence.summary: Four well-documented similar historical cases on this synthetic asset localized to bottle-presentation relationships; three required the same standard approved guide/presentation setup restoration and none required a timing change.
historical_evidence.boundary: Historical pattern strongly informs ranking but does not prove the current root cause or current physical state.

deterministic_interpretation.summary: The production concern strongly aligns with the standard guide/spacing restoration. The five-bottle diagnostic run improves toward the synthetic baseline after that one change.
deterministic_interpretation.bounded_finding: Five-bottle diagnostic evidence improves after restoring guide / spacing to the approved marked setup reference.
deterministic_interpretation.standard_change: Restore guide / spacing to the approved marked setup reference
deterministic_interpretation.standard_change_basis: Current visible alignment evidence, elevated presentation variability, unchanged production speed, and 3/4 highly similar CMMS cases with the same standard guide/presentation correction heavily align with this routine operator-friendly change.
deterministic_interpretation.causality_boundary: Strong alignment and an improved diagnostic run support the bounded intervention under the test conditions. They do not prove root cause, production recovery, or safe production change.

ranked_next_options.ranking_semantics: Current evidence alignment, historical CMMS support, and information value only. Rank is not root-cause probability or proof. In this synthetic plant, routine guide interventions are commissioned operator actions by default.

options.title: Restore guide / spacing to the approved marked setup reference
options.rationale: The detected pattern heavily aligns with the standard guide/presentation correction documented in 3/4 highly similar synthetic CMMS cases, while current camera and presentation-variability evidence remains compatible with that pattern.
options.historical_support: strong: 3/4 highly similar cases used the same standard approved guide/presentation correction
options.boundary: Perform one bounded standard change only, then arm and execute a five-bottle diagnostic run before any other material change.

options.title: Arm a five-bottle diagnostic trial
options.rationale: The standard change requires fresh bounded evidence before another material change.
options.boundary: Arming the trial creates the LineAlert workflow only. The operator executes the actual machine run from the HMI.

parameters_notice: All numeric values, historical records, operator permissions, standard changes, run-mode transitions, and ranked options are synthetic scenario parameters chosen for internal consistency and demo readability. They are not OEM thresholds, commissioned limits, safe operating limits, production recommendations, or proof of root cause.
